dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, smooth 2D geometric narrowing from the wide mid-body region toward the visible posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Off-white median pixel intensity with significant slate-grey shading along the lateral margins.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density distribution of small, localized dark-pixel clusters concentrated on the posterior half of the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between the bright central dorsal ridge and the more pigmented lateral flanks.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast dark circular aperture (blowhole) situated anteriorly; presence of several small, distinct dark-pixel spots on the posterior dorsal plane.
